Description: OXSIG AWS platform: ECS Fargate (ARM64) + ALB, RDS PostgreSQL, Secrets Manager, ECR, CloudWatch alarms, gross-cost budget, optional SES and EventBridge cleanup schedule.

VpcId.Description: VPC for the platform (the default VPC is acceptable).

PublicSubnetIds.Description: At least two public subnets in different AZs (ALB + Fargate).

DatabaseSubnetIds.Description: At least two subnets in different AZs for RDS (private preferred).

ContainerImage.Description: ECR image URI. Leave empty until the first image is pushed (service stays at 0 tasks).

DesiredCount.Description: Keep 0 until secrets are populated and the image is verified.

CertificateArn.Description: ACM certificate for the public hostname (same region). Empty = HTTP-only listener for internal testing.

DbEngineVersion.Description: Full RDS PostgreSQL version; match Neon 18.6 for forward-compatible migration.

DbParameterFamily.Description: RDS DB parameter group family corresponding to DbEngineVersion.

LabRuntimePolicyArn.Description: Existing managed policy with the EC2/SSM lab permissions currently granted to the Vercel OIDC role.

BedrockModelId.Description: Bedrock model or inference profile id enabled in this account.

SesIdentityDomain.Description: Optional domain to create as an SES identity (DKIM records are output; DNS is not changed).

EnableCleanupSchedule.Description: Enable only after CRON_SECRET is stored and Vercel cron is disabled.

Properties.GroupDescription: OXSIG app tasks: only reachable from the ALB
OXSIG PostgreSQL: only reachable from app tasks and migration tasks

Properties.Description: OXSIG runtime secrets (JSON). Required keys: DATABASE_URL, CLERK_SECRET_KEY, CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET, CRON_SECRET, OXSIG_TERMINAL_BRIDGE_SECRET, ABLY_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY, SENTRY_DSN, POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN, LAB_AWS_BLACK_DOMAIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD. Populate before raising DesiredCount.

Properties.AlarmDescription: OXSIG: elevated 5xx responses from app targets
OXSIG: p95 target response time above 2s
OXSIG: database free storage below 2 GiB
OXSIG: database connections above 70 (pool max is 12 per task)

Properties.Description: Daily lab expiry cleanup (replaces the vercel.json cron 17 2 * * *)

LoadBalancerDnsName.Description: Point a staging hostname here (DNS is not changed by this stack).

DatabaseMasterSecretArn.Description: RDS-managed master credentials (rotate-able). Build DATABASE_URL from it.

AppSecurityGroupId.Description: Use for one-off migration tasks (ecs run-task).

SesDkimRecords.Description: Add these three CNAMEs at your DNS provider to verify the SES domain.
